01 / MY STORY

From engineering
to real-world solutions.

A journey shaped between Cameroon and Tunisia, at the intersection of telecommunications, software development and digital technology.

After completing my scientific baccalaureate in Cameroon, I pursued higher education in Sfax, Tunisia, where I earned an engineering degree in Networks and Telecommunications. My professional experience then took me into systems administration, back-end development, Cloud and automation. Today, I bring this cross-functional background to technical and entrepreneurial projects.
